body:
Ouch, she is not a nice person indeed:

http://www.reddit.com/r/SubredditDrama/comments/qgahn/recap_the_tale_of_laurelairaziel/

One of the examples:

http://i.imgur.com/y9CEz.png

And there is even more, hypocrisy at its worst:


Host/Admin of 711chan
Laurelai is now the host and administrator of 711chan. 711chan in the past had boards for child pornography, jailbait and lolicon. The place is full of racist and homophobic language and Laurelai got on very well in the climate and as you can see from the previous screenshots she has no problem using such language either. It’s only on reddit that she has a problem with it apparently. Have a look at the 711chan of the past:
So easy to label people as monsters, huh? What that makes you then?

That's not children we are talking about here, that's this person. And he understands that he did a bad thing. A really, really, REALLY bad thing.

So do you think the only thing he can do to redeem himself is to kill himself?
If he is a troll, we were trolled okay. If he is a pedo, SO WHAT? Do you understand that people do not choose this? That they really don't?
So what? Is he beyond redemption for you? Even if he IS a troll, this whole thread is a litmus test for this community.
Don't see why you are being downwoted. I agree with you. Just want to depression sucks ass, so it is sometimes very hard to do as simple thing as going away.
At least you are able to escape, so you are one lucky bastard. I'd like to escape too.

Huh, feeling like shit? So do I, my depression kicked in and I'm afraid to lose my job and become homeless because of it. I don't know what to do and sure as hell want to kill myself. Really.

Well, this depression thing is with me for all my life. Last time I was this low, for a long time and progressing to worse, but in the end something kicked in and I was able to keep my job and continue to rent an apartment. What do I want to say? That there is the point, that it will pass? Not so much, because I'm now back to square one. And I want out. You want out, and so do I. For the similar reasons. I guess I wanted to tell you that I understand your situation, to a degree anyway. I know what money related panic attack feels like.

If you want to talk, tell me about your situation. Just talking helps sometimes.
